newsitem.title: USA: US economy could grow at 2.5 pct in H2 -- Price.
newsitem.headline: US economy could grow at 2.5 pct in H2 -- Price.

text.p: Acting Commerce Undersecretary Lee Price said on Thursday it was "plausible" that the U.S. economy could grow at an annualized rate of 2.5 percent in the second half of the year.
Asked what his growth prediction for the second half was, Price told Reuters "close to 2.5 percent seems plausible."

The Commerce Department earlier on Thursday said that Gross Domestic Product, the broadest measure of overall U.S. economic activity, grew at a 2.2 percent annualized rate in the second quarter of the year, down from a revised 4.9 percent in January-March.
